additional_info.body:
Hello Stefan, good afternoon.
Thank you for raising the ticket.
The errors that you are providing to me, it's someone that is rebooting the charger.
Now the question why the charging sessions are not being started is related to the authentication. I send a document in attachment for all the IDTags which are rejected.
Here is an example:
You need to check with your backend if this IDTag should be valid or not.
From our side, it doesn't look like there is any issue since other idTag are accepted.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
